image_description: A stocky, barrel-shaped marsupial (wombat) with coarse, dark grey/brown fur is foraging on a patch of grass and dirt. The animal has a broad, blunt head, small eyes, and rounded ears. Its body is low to the ground, exhibiting a quadrupedal stance. A faint watermark text 'divertida.com' is visible across the mid-section of the animal.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a semi-transparent watermark text 'divertida.com' overlaid on the animal. While legible, AI generators often struggle with rendering existing watermarks cleanly, or this may be a real image with a watermark. In the context of AI auditing, if this is generated, the text is surprisingly coherent but stylistically intrusive. If it's a real image used as a reference, it's not an artifact. Assuming potential generation, the integration of text into the fur texture without significant distortion is notable, but the presence of any text overlay is a deviation from a 'clean' natural image.
Slight softness/bleeding at the boundary between the dark fur and the bright grass blades, particularly around the back. This could be depth-of-field blur or slight generative smoothing.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'animal_pose_auditor' results. Wombats are stocky; ensure the model isn't hallucinating extra limbs hidden in the shadow or failing to detect the short front legs due to their unusual angle.
